rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically tickling someone or a body part.

example.english: The kids love to tickle Dad’s soles.
example.traditional: 細路仔最鍾意擳爸爸隻腳板。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zit1 baa4 baa1 zek3 goek3 baan2

rows.note: Use this when the body part itself has a tickly or itchy sensation, rather than when someone is touching it.

example.english: For some reason, my arm keeps feeling as though someone might tickle it.
example.traditional: 我隻手臂唔知點解成日痕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 bei3 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 seng4 jat6 han4

rows.note: Use this when something causes A to feel delighted or amused, not when someone is physically tickled.

example.english: This stand-up comedy really does tickle me.
example.traditional: 呢套棟篤笑真係令我開心。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 dung6 duk1 siu3 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 hoi1 sam1
